title: Three-coordinate input with two fixed values
statement: For indices $i,j\in\{0,1,2\}$ and signs $a,b,s\in\{-1,1\}$, form the three-coordinate sign vector that is constantly $s$, then set coordinate $i$ to $a$ and coordinate $j$ to $b$. If $i=j$, the value at that coordinate is $b$.
